notes.title: Related: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, coming March 13, 2026!
notes.content:
The third entry in the Monster Hunter RPG series, Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, will be coming out on March 13, 2026. The lastest details about the game were released during the TGS 2025 Capcom Online Program. Check out the characters, their Monsties, and the monsters they'll encounter!

[previewyoutube=gkJ1qtTPRZE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]◆ First Look at the Key Art[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/0e355be58ebbbd73b8530f2456b4a4bbd55a8df1.jpg[/img]

[b]◆ Characters[/b]
[b]Protagonist[/b]
Note: The protagonist's appearance, such as hairstyle and eye color, are customizable in the character creator.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/dfcf10e94e822f4ca6d907288826dbe47adb8ba8.png[/img]
The prince (or princess) of Azuria, and captain of the Rangers. They're highly skilled, and the only Rathalos Rider in the country. The protagonist has been focused on their Ranger duties, protecting monster ecosystems and researching egg quartz, when a shocking event changes everything. They come to realize they have little to no understanding of the events in the world or the hand humankind had in causing them, and in order to learn the truth, they set out across the Northern Meridian and into forbidden ground.

[b]Eleanor[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/e84dca59234f61f057becb0a2b244e3e1853d652.png[/img]
A Rider and the princess of Vermeil. As the situation in Vermeil worsens, relations with Azuria, as outlined by the nations' covenant, become increasingly strained. Eleanor offers herself as a hostage to Azuria in an attempt to ease the tensions. She cares deeply for her own Monstie, and is moved by witnessing the Rangers' activities. Wanting to understand her sister the queen's motivations, she accompanies the protagonist on their journey to the Northern Meridian.

[b]Rudy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/88cf41427cea41f54faa3b0d3651bcede5123636.png[/img]
A Royal Felyne, whose family has served Azuria's royalty for generations. He's served as the protagonist's Palico since they were very young, and bears a deep devotion to the king and the Azurian royal family. Though he feels conflicted about disobeying the king and leaving Azuria, he eventually makes the decision to travel with the protagonist across the Northern Meridian and toward the Sacrosanctum.

[b]Simon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/ab45519be8d1bd43002257b60e25fb4428672a11.png[/img]
A young man who's pleasant and agreeable with everyone. He has no family to speak of, and first met the protagonist while wandering the Azurian forest. Having grown up with the protagonist, he's their closest friend and confidante. The two of them entered the Rangers at the same time, and have worked together ever since. Simon admires the protagonist's mother Amara, who founded the organization.

[b]Thea[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/84b3c3d45bdc060fda484faaf34fc77bba40fa6a.png[/img]
A brand-new member of the Rangers. She loves Poogies and other creatures, and is naturally attuned to the world around her. Her innate skill led to her being chosen for the Rangers, and she follows the protagonist, whom she greatly admires, expressing her devotion through her actions. She's always accompanied by her Poogie, Pookie.

[b]Arken[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/83d0240a89243ecb8714d40e6e993b1d51de8b38.png[/img]
The king of Azuria and father of the protagonist. Despite faltering relations with their neighbor Vermeil, he maintains a steady, stoic demeanor. Wanting to uphold the covenant his forebears made with the Wyverians, he is strictly against anyone crossing the Northern Meridian. He has high expectations for the protagonist's ability to protect the country, as their sole Rathalos Rider.

[b]Amara[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/a99e5a5c817600e4bfbc08db6a9124f206a78cc8.png[/img]
The protagonist's mother and queen of Azuria. She founded the Rangers, with the aim of protecting and preservering the natural environment. Ten years prior, in opposition to the execution of one of the two Rathalos twins dubbed to be cursed, she absconded with one of them, never to be seen again.

[b]◆ The Monsties Bound in Kinship with Riders[/b]
"Monsties" are what Riders like the protagonist call the monsters with whom they've formed bonds. Monsties are valuable partners to their Riders, both in battle and out in the field.

[b]Ratha[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/80e94bb4afcfbb3afaf6ecd268e24a351759ad29.png[/img]
Rathalos were thought extinct in Azuria, but ten years prior, the protagonist's mother found a crystallized egg in the forest, from which Ratha was hatched. As one of a pair of twin Skyscale Rathalos, the birth was considered an omen of disaster. The protagonist's Monstie.

[b]Angie[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/b94b221b810c03f443b8486b947ce5d36f73a887.png[/img]
Eleanor's Monstie. Because it's a Monstie from Vermeil, it looks different than those you can find in Azuria.

[b]Kagachi[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/2df7ca63e99ba4499842f3db6bd5a22cfe4493e7.png[/img]
Thea's Monstie. From wall climbing to gliding, it's capable of a variety of Riding Actions.

[b]Fawn[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/43da313f8eafe712c9ead2e10e7c8b7370c509de.png[/img]
Simon's Monstie. Legiana are common Monstie choices among Azurian Rangers and Wyvern Brigade members.

[b]Honed Glavenus[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/4949e2c2611e3330ce5fc26a8d7375a7142906df.png[/img]
It is stronger than the regular species, and its whole body is covered in armor. While some think it has been artificially enhanced, details are unknown.

[b]Ratha V[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/6709fb3d49f310bab819f1059af7112b15d79272.png[/img]
A Skyscale Rathalos born ten years ago from egg quartz discovered in Blightstone Woods. As twins were prophesied to bring disaster, it was sentenced to death, but it fled Azuria with Amara's help. With its body now covered in armor, it's clearly the Monstie of some unknown Rider. It appears to stand in the way of the protagonist as they attempt to stop the fighting between the troops of Azuria and Vermeil.

[b]◆ The Monsters the Protagonist will Face[/b]
Feral Monsters
Feral monsters are considered more dangerous than their regular counterparts. The Crystal Encroachment affecting the land has spread to these monsters, causing Blightstones to appear on their bodies.

[b]Feral Chatacabra[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/5528d5e6c3da79e7e5f06d4258e5ffdc49ad9ab4.png[/img]
Using its long tongue, this Amphibian can grab objects and food from a distance.

[b]Magnamalo[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/573980325f284207fd1a164d0eb053302d3a36a4.png[/img]
A Fanged Wyvern clad in a heavy carapace.

[b]Rey Dau[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45725708/ffe0aba46a76a0d9dfe82d7f13188adffa4433e6.png[/img]
A luminous gold Flying Wyvern that dwells in sandy, arid regions.

[b]◆ Riding actions and the turn-based battle system have been improved and expanded![/b]
[b]Check the official website for more information![/b]
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/

notes.title: Everything you need to know about dens in Monster Hunter Stories 2
notes.content: Monster Hunter Stories 2 dens are where you’ll spend most of your time in the game. These are dungeons where some of the strongest monsters lurk, but more than that, they’re also where you’ll find Monster Hunter Stories 2 eggs to expand your Monstie team. Most spawn randomly, which means you’ll need to hunt a bit if you want the rare dens... Read more.

notes.title: How to get rare eggs in Monster Hunter Stories 2
notes.content: Rare Monster Hunter Stories 2 eggs are what should aim for when assembling the best Monstie team. Rare eggs have a higher chance of producing stronger Monsties, and while you can mostly get by without endless research and spreadsheets, you’ll still need to consider your genes for the late-game and PvP challenges... notes.title: Monster Hunter Stories 2 review - charming blend of hunting and RPG mechanics
notes.content:
Hunting isn't for everyone. With its myriad creatures the world of Monster Hunter is made for a Pokémon-type game, and so the Stories spin-offs feel like an attempt to offer a friendlier alternative, from cute anime-style character design right down to the core of the series. Monster Hunter Stories presents the idea that monsters can be friends instead of foes.

Right from the beginning, you can tell that Monster Hunter Stories 2 doesn't stray too far from its predecessor - you get to design your own character, who begins their training as a rider in the wake of strange happenings in their hometown. Navirou, the feline from the first game, once again comes along to declare himself your navigator and you're off, presumably to learn what it means to be a rider, a friend to monsters instead of their hunter.

If you haven't played the first game, don't worry - while there are references and recurring characters, you won't miss much in the way of context. In general, Monster Hunter Stories 2 is remarkably like the first Stories game. Your silent hero is, just like in the original Monster Hunter games, meant to serve as an avatar - in a game series that is about taking on monsters for the fun of it, that's enough, but just like its predecessor, Monster Hunter Stories 2 takes a very long time to come up with any sort of reason for why you're doing what you're doing, or why it has to be you at all; it doesn't have Pokémon's convenient excuse that both the battle and collection of monsters are the end goal, the way to mastery, if you want.

notes.title: Monster Hunter Stories 2 review
notes.content: I've always been a distant admirer of the Monster Hunter series with its gorgeous worlds and dangerous beasties, but no matter how many times I've tried to play—be it the early PSP forays or the more recent Monster Hunter World—it's never properly clicked for me. As much as I want to love the series, I've been unable to get past the five-hour mark. There are so many systems to learn and aspects to juggle that it can be overwhelming. Monster Hunter Stories 2 has changed that completely for me... Read more.
